description:
Mediocre grades. No specialty. Nothing I want to do.  
 
You're on the cusp of eighteen, about to start your senior year, and you're going through a full-blown "reality check." The meteor night is long.  
 
Everything seems to be off to a different start than your best friend, and your glamorous childhood seems like a dream you'll never have again. The more you think about it, the more self-defeating your thoughts become, and the deeper and darker the night gets. The night finally arrives, and as he escapes his noisy family, he encounters a peculiar-looking girl, Dawn, at a convenience store.  
 
The next day, she reappears as a new student in Yoo-sung's class. Even a double...!  
 
Dawn, who seems to be out of touch with reality. As they become friends, Yu-sung's time, which was stopped at night. gradually begins to flow towards the dawn!  
 
However, Dawn soon realizes that she too trapped in the deep night...  
 
This is a story about how we overcome the night to the dawn.  
 
How to love the dawn!
